entries.en: to trust in him; to rely on, lean upon someone
entries.notes: 语义四栏互证清晰，惟闽栏前两音节音调污损（T99），按低置信处理。

entries.en: to trust in him; to lean upon
〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 西栏中段残损（confiar de[残]ura con.）且与汉字栏『滿目』语义不协，官栏音又近『面目』，西文原词与英译无从定夺，中文暂依汉字、闽语两栏。

entries.en: to conform and to approve
entries.notes: 西栏清晰（Conformar y aprouer），汉、闽、官三栏皆空，中文释义无从对证。

entries.en: to confiscate; to seize and forfeit (property)
entries.notes: 语义四栏互证清晰，仅闽栏音调污损（T99），按低置信处理。

entries.zh: 没官；没收充公归官府（王室）
entries.en: to confiscate for the King; to forfeit to the Crown
entries.notes: 缩写 p̃ 按十七世纪惯例展开为 para（没收归王，与『没官』相应），闽栏首音节音调污损（T99）。

entries.en: to candy, preserve in sugar; a confection
entries.notes: 汉字栏碏/硝存疑且音读未能互证，依西栏 Confiter（confitar 一族）及 confites 上下文按糖渍蜜饯释义。

entries.en: comfits, candied sweetmeats; sugared grains
entries.notes: 汉字栏碏/硝存疑（若为『硝』则或指硝砂），闽栏末音节音调污损（T99），依西栏 confites 按糖渍蜜饯释义。

entries.zh: 糖花；糖制花式蜜饯、糖果
entries.en: confits, candied fruits; sugar flowers, fancy sweetmeats

entries.zh: 做茶料之人；制茶点蜜饯的师傅
entries.en: confectioner; maker of candied fruits and tea-sweetmeats
entries.notes: 汉字栏末字作『入』，而闽、官两栏末音节均与『人』相应，故按『做茶料人』释义；另有茶/菓之疑及闽栏音调污损（T99）。

entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
to conform oneself to something else; to follow, comply with
to conform to the likeness; to match, correspond
entries.notes: 语义四栏相合，仅官栏音调污损（T99），按低置信处理。

entries.zh: 合意思；顺从、投合他人心意
entries.en: to conform to another's opinion; to agree with, suit someone's mind
entries.notes: 官栏同一短语并存两读，汉字栏合/台存疑，按『合意思』（顺从他人意见）定释。

entries.zh: 合同；订立契约、使文书相合
entries.en: to conform a writing; to draw up or execute a contract
entries.notes: 西栏缩写 vt 未展开（疑为『及物动词』标记），汉字栏合/台存疑，按合同/契约释义。

entries.en: to conform to what went before; to keep to the old way
as before; to conform to what went before
according to what is written; conforming to the text of a document
to conform the will; to harmonize, reconcile
consonant, harmonious; in tune, attuned
to lean on, rely on; in conformity with that
entries.notes: 西栏『(conforme aeso)』拼写异常（疑为 confiar en eso 之讹），闽栏音调污损（T99），按倚靠、依循义定释。
